content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was missing, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted, so the compliant payer path is exhausted; resubmission or another appeal would not cure the authorization defect. The denial does not establish a contractual patient share, so billing the patient would be improper and the balance is uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
